title: High-Protein Breakfast Burrito Bowls
subtitle: A deconstructed breakfast burrito over rice with ground turkey, eggs, and black beans.
description: Seasoned ground turkey, scrambled eggs, black beans, and brown rice build into a bowl instead of a wrap, finished with pico de gallo, cheese, and avocado. It is a fork-and-bowl format for crews who want burrito flavor without the tortilla.

ingredients.name: greek yogurt
ingredients.notes: plain, in place of sour cream

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.instruction: Cook brown rice according to package directions. This takes the longest, so start it first and hold covered until bowls are built.

steps.title: Brown the ground turkey
steps.instruction: Brown ground turkey in a large skillet over medium-high, breaking it into crumbles. Stir in taco seasoning and a splash of water, and simmer 2 minutes until coated.

steps.title: Warm the black beans
steps.instruction: Warm black beans in a small saucepan with a pinch of salt and cumin while the turkey finishes.

steps.title: Scramble the eggs
steps.instruction: In a separate nonstick pan, scramble eggs over medium-low until just set. Keep them soft — they will finish warming once bowls are built.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.instruction: Layer rice, ground turkey, black beans, and scrambled eggs in each bowl. Top with pico de gallo, cheese, avocado, and a spoon of Greek yogurt if using.

stationWorkflow: Start the rice first since it takes the longest of any component.
Cook turkey, beans, and eggs in separate pans so each stays properly textured.
Set toppings out buffet-style so crew members can build bowls to their own taste.
cleanupNotes: Wipe the egg pan while still warm — cooked egg is much harder to scrub once cool.
Rinse the rice pot promptly so starch doesn't dry stuck to the bottom.
leftovers: Store rice, turkey, beans, and eggs in separate containers up to 4 days for the cleanest reheats.
Add pico, avocado, and yogurt fresh each time rather than storing them mixed in.
